[color=#f7c35a][b]Sleep Spell[/b][/color]
Human villagers sleep until the match ends. They can move around the map but cannot chat, vote, or do tasks.

[color=#f7c35a][b]Fog & Door Lock[/b][/color]
Fog covers nearby surroundings for 20 seconds. Doors lock for 10 seconds. Both share a two-minute recharge.

Use WASD, arrow keys, or the touch pad. Press E near a task or gong.
